messages:
ida: Short thread: need final buy-in for SDK examples and changelog wording for the structured output + function calling release next week. Customers keep copying strict TS examples and hitting runtime issues.

noah: Summary of proposal: default SDK surface remains permissive (to avoid breaking customers). Docs provide 3 tiers of examples: Quickstart (loose), Recommended (typed unions + guards), Strict (opt-in validator).

tara: For the Recommended examples, we should include a tiny runtime guard helper in TS and Python so users can copy/paste safely.

ben: Validator design: opt-in flag on client: `{ strictValidation: true }`. When enabled, attach `response.validationErrors` if any. Do not throw by default.

ida: Launch checklist (minimal): 1) Post copy/paste examples for TS + Py (quick + recommended + strict) 2) Add changelog blurb explaining default behavior + how to opt-in 3) CI tests covering polymorphic tool outputs 4) Docs snippet for Dedicated/Private toggle (env var + control plane).

noah: Owners: noah -> TS examples + tests, tara -> Py examples + changelog, ben -> validator API + perf numbers. CI bot will run smoke.

ci-bot: smoke-tests queued: sdk-typed-examples -> canary at 2026-07-14T08:00:00Z.

ida: Timeline: PRs for examples by Wed EOD, validator prototype by Thu, docs/changelog draft Wed. If blockers, escalate to release lead.

noah: Tiny TS helper to include in docs: `function isTable(x:any): x is {type:'table'; rows:any[]} { return !!x && x.type==='table' && Array.isArray(x.rows) }`. Use in snippet.

tara: Python equivalent suggested in docs: simple `def is_table(obj): return obj.get('type')=='table' and isinstance(obj.get('rows'), list)` guard.

ida: OK. Wrap up: keep defaults non-breaking, examples show best practices, strict mode opt-in. We'll reconvene if perf numbers from ben exceed 5ms p99. Thanks.
